info.title: Constellation Control Plane API
info.description: Phase 1 control-plane endpoints. Astronomer integration surfaces /api/v1/security/* alongside the standalone /api/v1/* routes.

ResponseRuleDef.description: E1 declarative response rule: binds a runtime event_type + condition set to an ordered set of actions. Evaluated server-side and pulled by the runtime-agent via the :sync bundle.

priority.description: Lower number is evaluated first (higher precedence).

AuthServer.description: B4 DB-backed auth provider (IdP). One of LDAP/SAML/OIDC. The config object's meaningful fields depend on type. Provider secrets (config.bind_password, config.sp_key_pem, config.client_secret) are returned redacted on read, and a redaction-marker echo on update preserves the stored secret.

name.description: Unique provider name within the org.

auth_order.description: Lower value is preferred when multiple providers of the same type are enabled.

config.description: Provider-specific configuration. LDAP: url, bind_dn, bind_password, base_dn, user_filter, group_attribute, email_attribute. SAML: idp_metadata_xml, entity_id, acs_url, sp_cert_pem, sp_key_pem, group_attribute, email_attribute. OIDC: issuer_url, client_id, client_secret, redirect_url, scopes.

role_mapping.description: Maps IdP-supplied group/attribute values (lower-cased) to Constellation role names, with an optional default role.

SystemConfig.description: Runtime-mutable system configuration. Secret-bearing fields (ca_bundle_pem, and any credentials embedded in egress_proxy.https_proxy) are returned redacted on GET.

https_proxy.description: Outbound HTTP(S) proxy URL. Embedded credentials are redacted on read.

tls_verify.description: Whether shared outbound clients verify upstream TLS certificates (default true).

ca_bundle_pem.description: Additional trusted CA bundle (PEM). Returned redacted when set.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard JSON error envelope returned by API handlers.

get.description: Streams the calling org's configuration as a YAML document suitable for storing in git and re-applying via the import endpoint. Includes users, custom roles, role bindings, org settings, policies, groups, vuln profiles, response rules, receivers, registries, WAF/DLP rules, custom frameworks, and an API-token inventory. Secrets never leave in cleartext: user password hashes and API-token hashes are blanked, registry credentials are emitted still AES-GCM-sealed, and the registry KEK is stripped. Requires the manage_org verb.

200.description: The org configuration document rendered as YAML.

500.description: The configuration could not be assembled or serialized.

post.description: Applies an uploaded YAML configuration document to the calling org. The merge-vs-replace selector is REQUIRED via the mode query parameter: mode=merge upserts rows by natural key and leaves not-present rows untouched; mode=replace additionally deletes the org's rows whose natural key is absent from the document (scoped to the org, so it can never affect another tenant). API tokens are metadata-only and never written. Requires the manage_org verb.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Apply semantics: 'merge' (upsert by natural key) or 'replace' (upsert and delete-not-present, scoped to the org).

200.description: Per-table apply statistics (new / updated / skipped row counts).

400.description: Missing/invalid mode parameter, unparseable YAML, or an apply error.

delete.summary: Proxy a delete request to a federated joint (admin)
delete.description: Cross-cluster admin reverse-proxy (D3). Forwards the request to the joint resolved from its federation membership endpoint, stripping the inbound Authorization/Cookie and hop-by-hop headers and attaching the master's own federation credential (a short-lived D1 sync ticket, plus a CA-issued client certificate when D2 mTLS is enabled). The target host is taken ONLY from the registered endpoint, so it can never be pointed at an arbitrary URL. RBAC: GET is open to any reader but a non-admin is limited to a read-only path allowlist; POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE require the manage_org verb (federation admin).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Federated cluster id (cluster_id of a registered fed member). Must resolve to a known membership row; an unregistered id returns 404 (SSRF guard — the target host is never caller-supplied).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The joint API sub-path to forward, captured by the route wildcard and prefixed with /api/v1 on the joint (e.g. 'findings', 'scan-results/{digest}'). Scheme and host always come from the registered endpoint, never from this value.

200.description: The joint's response, streamed back verbatim (status, headers minus hop-by-hop, and body).

403.description: Caller lacks the required verb (non-admins may only GET allowlisted read paths; mutating verbs require manage_org), or the target cluster is revoked.

404.description: No federation membership row for {id} in the caller's org, or the member has no registered endpoint.

502.description: The joint endpoint is unreachable or returned an invalid response.

post.summary: Exchange a federation join token for a per-cluster sync secret
post.description: Anonymous exchange endpoint (D1/D2). A joining cluster presents a join token (a signed, master-minted token or the pre-shared fixed GitOps token) plus its cluster id/name and receives a per-cluster signed sync ticket it then presents on every /federation/sync poll. Only the sha256 of the ticket is persisted by the master (like api_tokens). Authenticated by the join token itself, so it carries no bearer security. When per-joint mTLS (D2) is enabled the response also includes a per-joint client certificate, its private key (shown once), and the master CA: the joint presents the client cert on every /sync poll and the master verifies it against the CA, so a leaked bearer ticket alone — without the matching client key — is rejected.

join_token.description: Signed master-minted join token, or the pre-shared fixed token

client_cert.description: D2: PEM per-joint client certificate (CN = cluster_id), present only when mTLS is enabled

client_key.description: D2: PEM private key for the client certificate (shown once), present only when mTLS is enabled

ca_cert.description: D2: PEM master federation CA the joint pins on its /sync connection, present only when mTLS is enabled

500.description: Credential persistence or certificate issuance failed

post.summary: Mint a short-lived signed federation join token
post.description: Master-only (D1). Mints an RS256-signed, short-lived join token an operator hands to a joining cluster to bootstrap trust. Requires the org to be in the federation master state and the manage-org verb. The optional ttl_seconds shortens (never extends) the configured ceiling.

ttl_seconds.description: Optional shorter lifetime; capped at the configured ceiling

409.description: Org is not a federation master

get.summary: Pull the master's federated rule revisions (joint poll)
get.description: Per-cluster federation credential auth (D1), NOT a user JWT. The joint presents its signed per-cluster sync ticket as the bearer; the master validates the signature and the fed_credentials row (live, not revoked, epoch current) before returning rule revisions strictly greater than ?since=. A generic read-findings principal can no longer reach this endpoint.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Return revisions strictly greater than this revision number

parameters.name: cluster_id
parameters.description: Legacy joint identity; ignored when the credential supplies it

200.description: Rule revisions since the requested revision

401.description: Missing or invalid federation sync ticket

get.description: Returns a merged, time-ordered timeline across DPI threats, runtime events, network violations, and audit rows. Supports NeuVector-style category filtering through source, severity, time-window, text, namespace, workload, and reference filters.

parameters.name: cluster_id
parameters.description: Optional cluster scope. Audit rows are org-level and omitted when this is set.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Comma-separated timeline sources: dpi_threat,runtime_event,network_violation,audit.

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: Comma-separated normalized severities: critical,high,medium,low,info.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower RFC3339 time bound. Defaults to seven days before now.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive upper RFC3339 time bound. Defaults to now plus one minute.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text match against normalized title, id, workload, namespace, and reference fields.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Namespace substring filter.

parameters.name: workload
parameters.description: Workload substring filter.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Source reference substring filter, such as threat id, verdict, policy, or audit target kind.

get.description: Returns the org's live runtime system configuration (egress proxy, TLS verify + CA bundle, syslog/SIEM target, scanner autoscale bounds) with secrets redacted. Requires the manage_system_config verb.

200.description: The current configuration (secrets redacted) and its revision.

source.description: Effective source for the returned config: system_config when persisted, default when no row exists.

updated_at.description: Last persisted update timestamp for the system_config row.

updated_by.description: User ID that last updated the system_config row, when recorded.

updated_by_email.description: Email for the user that last updated the system_config row, when available.

patch.description: Applies a partial, validated update to the org's system configuration and bumps the revision so in-process consumers hot-reload without a restart. Only the keys present in the body are changed; unknown keys are rejected. A ca_bundle_pem or credentialed egress proxy echoed back as the redaction marker is left unchanged. Requires the manage_system_config verb.

200.description: The merged configuration (secrets redacted) and its new revision.

400.description: Invalid patch body or a field that failed validation.

409.description: The configuration was changed concurrently; retry with the latest revision.
